## Definition
A model that combines hypergraph neural networks with state-space representations to capture high-order dependencies in sequential data. Enables efficient processing of complex temporal-spatial patterns in network traffic, relevant for TCC's topology-aware computing and iNEST's neuromorphic event streams.
